content:
You can paginate a list of cold indexes. Conﬁgure the number of indexes to be returned per page
with the page_size parameter (default is 10). Every _search request on your cold indexes
returns a pagination_id which you can use for subsequent calls.
The following request paginates the results of a _search request of your cold indexes and displays
the next 100 results:
GET _cold/indices/_search?page_size=100
{
"pagination_id": "je7MtGbClwBF/2Zp9Utk/h3yCo8nvbEXAMPLEKEY"
}
